findings.evidence: Opening explicitly labels Splatoon 3 actual recording. Following explanation says our Unity model and development case Splatoon 2, 2017. Native source aspect ratio and game UI remain intact. The surface focus surrounds inspected wall glints rather than the central weapon flash; later sampled frames clear the focus. Earlier source-target audit remains in native-focus-review.json.

Sheets 03-05 retain the same floor, wall and framing. Shading reads 1.00 to 0.00 while specular remains 0.30. The dark wall becomes flat bright team colors; the wall/floor leader marks the relevant junction. No black reset or overlay hides the changing surface.

The term card is present during p5-1 at 38.2167-40.4167-second samples, then absent at p5-2 samples 41.6333 and 41.7167 seconds. The bright floor reflection changes visibly with displayed specular values 1.95 and 2.18; shading stays 0.55. The character and the floor remain uncovered by the definition overlay.

At 46.4167 seconds the same-splash label sits above the particle cluster. Its leader points to the ring without a filled panel covering the droplets. Caption remains below the hero view and cat below the caption. At 54.5167, 56.05 and 57.8667 seconds the reduced-specular closing comparison shows the particles and ring with the same target.

All 79 sheet samples retain the same caption region, at most two lines, with readable white boxes and no collision with hero image, parameter readback, step list or cats. Headline, canonical terms, picture-kind labels and meaningful three-step emphasis remain in their allocated areas. Native p6-5/6/7 text is complete and unclipped.
